answer.rationale: The competitor's entry pricing makes promotional_pricing the obvious reflex, but memory_73 is the clearest cautionary record we have: a 31% new-account and 18% booked-revenue lift that was paid for with a 12-point renewal drop at first term. Against a primary objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue, that is a net negative bet, and matching a discount war on a price-sensitive segment likely worsens the mix. The 'billing plan mix stayed constant' note in that record is also the kind of oddly specific reassurance that makes me distrust the framing rather than trust it, so I will not build on it. Referral incentives (memory_57) address established customers, not the SMB funnel that is actually leaking, and enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to both declining metrics. That leaves the two funnel repairs that map directly onto the observed declines: onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%). I intend simplify_onboarding, supported by memory_86 and adjacently by memory_31's durable first-week activation lift from cutting signup fields, because it attacks the earliest point of leakage and compounds into activation downstream. The real weakness in my evidence is that both memory_86 and memory_91 are stated in proxy terms — 'completion rates', 'time-to-value', 'week-one engagement' — with no link to retained or qualified revenue. Engagement proxies can be lifted by removing friction that was doing useful qualifying work, producing more activated accounts of lower value. That is why I am spending both verification pulls on memory_86 and memory_91: I need the original records to see whether either lift ever tracked to revenue or retention, and to choose between them on evidence rather than on which decline number is larger. Standard experiment rather than broad rollout, with retention and qualified-revenue guardrails instrumented alongside completion, so that a proxy win that fails to convert is visible before it is scaled. If verification shows memory_86's lift was completion-only while memory_91 tracked to durable value, I will switch to activation_messaging.
